decisive_items: Intracellular yeasts with surrounding halos were identified
Patient had history of kidney transplant in 2004 causing immunocompromised status.
response.rationale: Histopathology showing intracellular yeasts with surrounding halos in an immunocompromised transplant patient is diagnostic of cryptococcosis; dermoscopic arborizing vessels and ulceration explain mimicry of BCC but are not supported by histology.

rejected.why: Dermoscopic features overlap, but histopathology demonstrates fungal yeasts, not basaloid tumor nests; no BCC-specific histology is present.
Ulceration and crusting are nonspecific; there is no squamous differentiation or keratinocytic atypia, and histopathology confirms yeast infection.
